description: Run your own read-only SPARQL SELECT or ASK against the Publications Office of the European Union CELLAR endpoint, for EU-document questions no purpose-built tool covers — citation graphs, amendment chains, EuroVoc concept traversal, cross-institution counts. The Common Data Model prefix `cdm:` is <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>. Writes (INSERT/DELETE/LOAD/CLEAR) are refused, and results are capped.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 50, max 500). Applied on top of any LIMIT already in the query.

query.description: A SPARQL SELECT or ASK query. Virtuoso full-text search is available as `?lit bif:contains "'phrase'"`. CELEX literals are typed xsd:string — a plain string will match nothing.

name: cellar_sparql
